page.layout: Two columns of an alphabetical index under a centred title. Left column: index entries, running from the top to the bottom edge of the scan. Right column, set higher on the page: index entries, cut off at the bottom edge of this part.; Two columns on the scan. Left column, lower part only: index entries under the letter F. Right column, from top to bottom: end of the F entries, then letter G and its entries. No running head, page number or catchword.

main_text.head: Tertius Index
main_text.l: Felis,sitne γαλῆ[?]. 281. 7: occursu suo auspicium faciebat. 281. 8.11.282.13. 283.13
ad Fidem magni momenti sunt vocis tenor,& actio. 208.18. 22
Fœneratores infames. 229. 17 furibus peiores. 186.24, Fœneratorum techna. 186.32 pœna. 229.19.21

page.notes: The Greek words "γαλῆ" and "ἐφέαν" are doubtful at the letter level; the Greek of the entry "ἐφέαν" may be misprinted. The last line on the left and the right column are cut off at the bottom edge of this part, so the final entries are incomplete here. Lower left of the left column: the first line is too damaged to read. Section letters and running numbers are copied as printed. "Glorio-sus" at the foot is a catchword-like word cut by the page edge; it is kept as a line of the index. Doubtful: "scissum" (printed "sciffum"), "fuę" (printed "fuę" with cedilla), and "præconū" (macron as printed).
